description: Source code for the Equation class in the GraphControl module, handling equation rendering, request generation, and properties related to graphing equations.

classes.name: Equation
classes.description: Represents a mathematical equation with methods for generating graph requests and managing visual properties.

methods.name: GetRequest
methods.description: Generates a MathML request string for plotting the equation, determining the type of plot based on the expression content.

methods.name: GetExpression
methods.description: Removes specific formatting prefixes from the expression's MathML data.

methods.name: LineColor::get
methods.description: Gets the current line color for the equation.

methods.name: LineColor::set
methods.description: Sets the line color for the equation and triggers property change notification if changed.

methods.name: LineColorPropertyName::get
methods.description: Returns the property name string for the line color property.

methods.name: IsGraphableEquation
methods.description: Determines if the equation is suitable for graphing based on its expression and state flags.
